evidence.source: Development fast-lane rollout run 30931550512 on 381e2d0, completed successfully. Corroborated read-only: the ledger holds 97 rows through 20260804253000; both custody tables exist in predictor_internal and NEITHER exists in public, so no browser role can reach them by any route; anon and authenticated hold no SELECT on provider_raw_responses. Behaviourally, inside a rolled-back transaction, three inserts were attempted and exactly one was stored: a URL carrying api_key=SECRET was refused by check violation, an unlisted set-cookie response header was refused, a clean row was accepted, and its raw_body_sha256 was generated by the database rather than supplied. No provider was called and provider-poll is not deployed.
